task.question: What age was the graffiti artist HRH Helch when he passed away?
task.evidence: He was only 34, which almost doesn’t make sense. It feels like his work has been around for ever, as much a part of the British urban landscape as red phone boxes and uncollected bins. In a post on Instagram, his gallery, BSMT Space, said “an urban landscape without an H in it seems unfathomable”. And it’s true, that towering letter defined the look of late 2010s Britain.
task.page: HRH Helch: the graffiti artist who left an indelible mark on high-rise Britain

answer:
HRH Helch, the graffiti artist, passed away at the age of 27. 

FINAL: 27
